frequency_v2_q0401.prompt: After a long workday, your partner complains that you didn't talk at all today.

options.frequency_v2_q0401_c: I give a quick recap and go back to my own thing.
options.frequency_v2_q0401_d: I suggest spending quiet time together.

frequency_v2_q0402.prompt: You've been seeing someone new for a few weeks. They want to tag you on social media or share a photo of the two of you.

options.frequency_v2_q0402_c: I prefer to keep things private.
options.frequency_v2_q0402_d: If the pace picks up, I limit what gets shared.

frequency_v2_q0403.prompt: Your partner started getting involved in—or offering opinions on—a family matter of yours (parents, siblings).

options.frequency_v2_q0403_b: I'd say, "Don't get involved in this."
options.frequency_v2_q0403_d: I shut the topic down completely.

frequency_v2_q0404.prompt: You had a plan. Your partner is leaving it vague: "Maybe we'll do something else—I can't decide."

frequency_v2_q0405.prompt: Your partner gives you a compliment—about your looks, intelligence, or character—in a way you find over the top.

options.frequency_v2_q0405_a: I thank them and move on.
options.frequency_v2_q0405_c: I say something similar back to them.

frequency_v2_q0406.prompt: You want to spend a quiet evening together, but your partner wants to start a long, serious conversation about the relationship right then. What do you do?

options.frequency_v2_q0406_a: I'd clearly suggest leaving that conversation for another time instead of getting into it tonight.
options.frequency_v2_q0406_b: I listen briefly, then say I'd rather pick it up later.
options.frequency_v2_q0406_c: I say I'd prefer to keep things light but stay with it if the conversation continues.
options.frequency_v2_q0406_d: I give up my evening preference and fully engage in the talk.

frequency_v2_q0407.prompt: You're getting to know someone new. They say things like "I miss you" in almost every message or every time you meet.

options.frequency_v2_q0407_a: I respond in a similar way.
options.frequency_v2_q0407_b: I gently keep my own pace.
options.frequency_v2_q0407_c: I'd say, "Let's slow down a little."
options.frequency_v2_q0407_d: If it gets too intense, I pull back.

frequency_v2_q0408.prompt: Your partner keeps questioning a decision of yours—a job change, moving cities, or a hobby.

options.frequency_v2_q0408_c: I listen to their view too.

frequency_v2_q0409.prompt: After an argument, your partner wanted to be alone and went to their room. After a while they came back to the shared space, but the issue still isn't resolved. What do you do?

options.frequency_v2_q0409_a: When the moment feels right, I'd bring the issue up myself and suggest that we sort things out.
options.frequency_v2_q0409_b: I wait for things to normalize a bit, then suggest talking the same day.
options.frequency_v2_q0409_c: I don't reopen it that day; I come back to it calmly the next day.
options.frequency_v2_q0409_d: If they don't bring it up, I won't either.

frequency_v2_q0410.prompt: You've met someone new a few times. They're suggesting spending most of the coming weekend together. What do you do?

options.frequency_v2_q0410_a: I happily agree and plan both days together.
options.frequency_v2_q0410_b: I suggest spending most of one day together and keeping the rest separate.
options.frequency_v2_q0410_c: I suggest a shorter meetup and keep the pace a bit slower.
options.frequency_v2_q0410_d: For now, I'd rather keep seeing each other in shorter stretches than spend an entire weekend together.

frequency_v2_q0411.prompt: Your partner can't decide whether to stay home or go out and keeps wanting both at once.

frequency_v2_q0412.prompt: You're planning a trip together. Your partner wants every detail nailed down in advance.

options.frequency_v2_q0412_b: I say a general outline is enough.
options.frequency_v2_q0412_d: I say, "You plan it—I'll go along."

frequency_v2_q0413.prompt: Your partner implies they're uncomfortable with how close you are to a friend.

options.frequency_v2_q0413_a: I'd put some distance between myself and that friend.
options.frequency_v2_q0413_c: I suggest getting the three of you together.

frequency_v2_q0414.prompt: While talking to someone new, they move into deep topics very quickly—family, past wounds, fears.

options.frequency_v2_q0414_b: I listen but share little about myself.
options.frequency_v2_q0414_d: I'd try to steer the conversation toward lighter topics.

frequency_v2_q0415.prompt: When your partner hears about something you achieved, they react less enthusiastically than you expected.

options.frequency_v2_q0415_a: I don't let it bother me.
options.frequency_v2_q0415_b: I say, "I was hoping you'd be a little more excited."
options.frequency_v2_q0415_d: I bring it up again later.

frequency_v2_q0416.prompt: You've been seeing someone new for a few weeks. They say, "I'm thinking of this as something serious."

options.frequency_v2_q0416_d: If the pace speeds up, I step back.

frequency_v2_q0417.prompt: You go to an event together. Your partner is very social, while you're more reserved.

options.frequency_v2_q0417_b: I stay at my own pace.
options.frequency_v2_q0417_c: After a while, I'd suggest leaving.
options.frequency_v2_q0417_d: I say, "You have fun—I'll hang back."

frequency_v2_q0418.prompt: Your partner found out a secret of yours—health, family, or your past—and asked, "Why didn't you tell me?"

frequency_v2_q0419.prompt: You're getting to know someone new. They're very physically affectionate, while you prefer more personal space.

options.frequency_v2_q0419_a: I try to get used to it.
options.frequency_v2_q0419_c: I'd say, "I move a little more slowly with physical closeness."
options.frequency_v2_q0419_d: If the pace doesn't fit, I pull back.

frequency_v2_q0420.prompt: Your partner is indirectly hinting at a feeling or need involving you.

options.frequency_v2_q0420_b: I pick up on it and respond accordingly.
options.frequency_v2_q0420_c: I wait for them to be clearer.

frequency_v2_q0421.prompt: Your partner said they don't like a choice of yours—your hair, clothes, or a hobby.

frequency_v2_q0422.prompt: After a few dates with someone new, they said, "I've been telling my friends about you."

options.frequency_v2_q0422_c: I'd listen, but I wouldn't say much about myself.
options.frequency_v2_q0422_d: If the pace picks up, I slow down.

frequency_v2_q0423.prompt: Your partner is juggling several social plans at once and wants to include you too.

options.frequency_v2_q0423_b: I'm selective about which ones I go to.
options.frequency_v2_q0423_d: I suggest my own plan instead.

frequency_v2_q0424.prompt: Your partner keeps bringing up a habit of yours—phone use, running late, messiness.

options.frequency_v2_q0424_b: I say, "That's just how I am."
options.frequency_v2_q0424_c: I point out something of theirs in return.
options.frequency_v2_q0424_d: I ask them to drop it.

frequency_v2_q0425.prompt: On a particular issue, your partner thinks they're right and won't back down.

options.frequency_v2_q0425_a: I look for a middle ground.
options.frequency_v2_q0425_b: I stand firm on my view.
options.frequency_v2_q0425_d: I ask more questions to understand.

frequency_v2_q0426.prompt: While texting someone new, they write long messages and you prefer shorter ones.

options.frequency_v2_q0426_a: I start writing longer messages too.
options.frequency_v2_q0426_b: I stick to my own style.
options.frequency_v2_q0426_c: I'd say, "I tend to keep my messages short."
options.frequency_v2_q0426_d: If the pace doesn't fit, I text less often.
